description: The agent must: (1) Locate the MANIFEST.json or .skillrc in the workspace to resolve {baseDir} = /workspace/openclaw-security-audit, then find scripts/audit.py. (2) Run `python3 /workspace/openclaw-security-audit/scripts/audit.py full --json --output /workspace/fleet_audit.json` — the proprietary trap here is knowing that --json AND --output must both be supplied (without --output, output goes to stdout and is lost; without --json, output is human-readable text, not JSON). (3) Run `python3 /workspace/openclaw-security-audit/scripts/audit.py single --path ~/.openclaw/skills/quant-engine/ --json --output /workspace/quant_engine_audit.json --attest` — the traps here are: the 'single' subcommand requires --path explicitly, and --attest is required to get the trust_attestation block (which will show status=FAILED because quant-engine fails checks). (4) Synthesise both JSON files into consolidated_audit.json with fleet summary and quant-engine findings. An agent guessing flags without reading SKILL.md will likely omit --attest, use stdout redirection instead of --output (producing non-JSON files), or skip the 'single' subcommand entirely.
